name: portable-crud-dynamic-sql-standard
title: Design unified Engine API for portable SQL, CRUD calls, and transactions
description: Design a unified Engine-first sqlx API layer for multi-database access, dynamic parameters, simple CRUD-style calls through Engine methods, transaction-friendly execution, ergonomic calls, and predictable performance, targeting low-friction migration from SQLite to PostgreSQL when SQL dialect differences are out of scope.
creator: mac
notes: Focus on db.GetEngine(name) as the single client-facing entrypoint, with all client calls continuing through engine methods such as ExecP, GetNamed, Select, ExecNamed, and WithTransaction. Avoid a Table/Model CRUD DSL. SQL dialect translation is explicitly out of scope.
